From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Market brief: pricing movements & model launches — QBR prep

Team — attaching a short market flash ahead of next week's QBR. High-level takeaways in the first bullets; details in the attached spreadsheet and the competitor bulletin PDF. Please skim and flag any items you want on the QBR agenda.

Highlights (quick):
- OrionAI announced a usage-tier cut for standard text-gen (up to 18% list price reduction for select tiers). They positioned it as a "volume acceleration" play.
- MeridianModels released "Meridian-X" (dense-parameter release with aggressive quantization). Early reports show 8–12% latency improvements on similar GPUs; they also publish a permissive license for fine-tuning.
- A small EU marketplace vendor (NimbusCloud) is re-bundling open models with regional infra; potential impact for our EU deals that demand localized hosting.

Implications for us (initial asks):
1) Pricing pressure: Sales should prepare refreshed unit-economics scenarios if Orion price cuts accelerate.
2) Positioning: Product/Marketing should call out our reliability/fallback story vs. Meridian's single-optimization angle.
3) Regional play: Ops/Private should give a short note on what it would take to match Nimbus' regional bundling for EU customers.

Attachments: price_delta_summary.xlsx, competitor-bulletins.pdf
Shared draft for QBR deck: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C4d-competitor-deck
HubSpot reference (example deal): https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/view/890

Asking: please send 1–2 bullet comments by EOD Tuesday so I can fold into the QBR agenda.

—Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

Marissa — thanks for this. Two quick things from GTM/sales POV:
- If Orion's cut is limited to certain tiers, we should model the cross-over point where a customer would switch to Orion on pure price. I'll work with pricing analytics to get a simple break-even chart by Wednesday.
- Meridian-X speed claims look real on synthetic tests, but we need to map the perf gains to our common customer workloads (longer contexts). I'll ask eng to run a 2-customer workload comparison; ETA Friday.

Action: I'll own a 1-slide impact chart (who: Karthik; due: Wed EOD).

Karthik
VP, Enterprise Sales
